quote.text: The only really leisured people are those who devote time to acquiring true knowledge rather than trivia.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • True leisure in parenting means investing time in nurturing a child's intellectual and emotional growth, focusing on wisdom rather than trivial distractions.
    • By modeling a passion for meaningful learning, parents cultivate resilience and curiosity in their children, equipping them to distinguish valuable knowledge from fleeting entertainments.
  • Leadership
    • A leader who prioritizes genuine understanding over superficial details inspires a culture of depth and purpose, leading teams with clarity and integrity.
    • Devoting time to deep, thoughtful insights enables leaders to navigate challenges wisely, ensuring decisions are grounded in what truly enriches both the individual and the collective.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, true leisure arises from dedicating energy to studying customer needs and market realities, rather than chasing transient trends or trivial metrics.
    • Focusing on core knowledge and meaningful data allows one to create products that serve enduring purposes, fostering user engagement that transcends momentary fads.
